subject: Marketplace listing: security evidence triage for AWS/GCP co-sell
messages:
From: Lena Park <marketplace-ops@acmecorp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:13:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood listing - security evidence needed for AWS/GCP catalog

Hi Mina,

Thanks for engaging — AcmeCorp is evaluating Redwood for a co-sell listing across AWS and GCP marketplaces. The marketplace review requires the following artifacts before we can progress:

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 attestation letter)
- Recent vendor penetration test letter (redacted OK)
- Executed Data Processing Agreement (DPA) or template with notes on data residency
- Network/IP allowlist and high-level network segmentation diagram
- Confirmation of encryption at-rest/ in-transit and KMS usage

Can you share the docs or point me to a secure link? Ideally we need these in the next 5 business days to keep our internal timeline. Also flag anything you cannot share publicly and we can coordinate NDA / secure upload.

Best,
Lena Park
Marketplace Ops — AcmeCorp

Attachment: none
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <marketplace-ops@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing - security evidence needed for AWS/GCP catalog

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list and timeline. Looping in Karthik (security/compliance) and Jonas (partnerships) to triage.

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2 Type II: we have a 2025 report and an attestation letter; shareable under NDA for some customers but we can provide a redacted version for marketplace reviewers.
- Pen test: we have a 2026 vendor pen-test letter; will redact hostnames and sensitive IPs.
- DPA: we have an executed DPA template and we can provide a signed copy for AcmeCorp once countersigned — do you need a countersigned PDF or will a standard executed copy suffice?
- Network diagram & IPs: we can provide a high-level segmentation diagram and an allowlist range; detailed topology requires restricted sharing (we can upload to an SFTP or SharePoint behind an NDA).
- KMS/encryption: char summary below and Karthik will provide the certs/controls snapshot.

Next steps:
1) Karthik — can you assemble a redacted pack (SOC2, pen test letter) and the controls snapshot?
2) Jonas — I'll need you to confirm marketplace co-sell artifacts and whether Acme needs a DocuSign DPA or the executed one will be uploaded to the marketplace portal.
3) Lena — if you can confirm the secure upload method (DocuSign secure links, Hub upload, or SFTP), well stage the materials there.

Thanks — aiming to have the redacted pack by Thu 15 Jul.

Warmly,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Partner Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

Hi all — attaching a redacted evidence bundle for the marketplace reviewers. Summary of included artifacts:

- Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (redacted to remove customer-specific identifiers)
- Redwood_PenTest_Letter_2026-redacted.pdf (third-party vendor attestation; hostnames removed)
- Executed_DPA_AcmeCorp_2026.pdf (signed copy — we redacted internal signatures for public display per legal)
- network_segmentation_diagram_v2.png (high-level segmentation; no VPC IDs)

Notes:
- SOC2: our SOC 2 Type II covers the inference platform and control environment; the report includes scope notes. We can provide the full report under an NDA if Acme requires the unredacted version for procurement.
- Pen test: this is the standard letter from our vendor; details of exploited paths are omitted in the redacted copy.
- DPA: executed with our standard data residency clause for US customers; if Acme needs EU-specific residency language, we have a separate addendum.
- IP ranges: we can provide a CIDR allowlist but will only share the full ranges over a secure channel; please confirm preferred method.

Jonas — I included a short legal-friendly blurb for the marketplace listing: "Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II attestation, annual third-party penetration testing, and executed DPAs with enterprise customers; encryption at-rest and in-transit is standard across deployments and KMS is used for key management." Let me know if you want any edits for marketplace copy.

Next: if Acme confirms DocuSign secure link or Hubspot file, we will upload the attachments by EOD.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Security Engineer — Red Team Liaison
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (pdf, redacted); Redwood_PenTest_Letter_2026-redacted.pdf (pdf); Executed_DPA_AcmeCorp_2026.pdf (pdf); network_segmentation_diagram_v2.png (png)

Hi Karthik / Mina — received everything, thanks — the redacted SOC2 and pen test letter look good for the marketplace intake. Procurement will need the executed DPA PDF (we have a DocuSign flow for countersignature) and the allowlist CIDRs for our firewall team.

Action items we are tracking on our side:
- Procurement (Acme) to confirm DocuSign route by Mon 20 Jul
- Firewall team to review CIDR ranges once you share them over SFTP (we flagged that as the preferred secure channel)
- Marketplace ops will mark the listing as "pre-cleared" pending the final CIDRs and countersigned DPA

One small ask: can you provide a one-paragraph vendor attestation (signed) that the redacted materials represent the complete set of artifacts for marketplace review? That helps speed legal sign-off.

If you prefer, I can generate the DocuSign envelope and add Redwood as a signer.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
